summary: Into the new week the composite risk score stands at 43.13 and the model still reads caution inside a goldilocks regime, with the 1-day trend flat and the 1-week trend at 1.24. Risk is lopsided rather than elevated: macro is the only stretched dimension at 65.38, carried by a 2.43 real rate and a 4.69 nominal 10Y yield, while volatility at 25.15 and liquidity and credit at 33.62 stay benign, with VIX easing to 15.15 and high-yield spreads to 2.71. The last close was broadly risk-on — 20 of the 22 tracked sectors and themes advanced and AI Software gained 6.0538 percent — yet the memory theme fell -2.202 percent even as A-share memory names such as GigaDevice rose 8.3247 percent and Longsys 5.5333 percent, a geographic split that deserves attention. The labour print underneath is the uncomfortable part: payrolls came in at -23.0 against 20.0 previously, but the jobless rate still fell to 4.1 because participation slipped to 61.4 and continuing claims rose to 1801000. Model confidence is high at 0.9211 now that the volatility dimension is fully covered again, so the open question is interpretation, not data quality — and note that the geopolitical headlines behind this read come from relayed Chinese aggregators.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Macro is the only stretched dimension at 65.38: the 10Y real rate sits at 2.43, in the 99.04 percentile, and the nominal 10Y yield at 4.69 is in the 98.0 percentile. The composite is rate-driven, not stress-driven.

Cross-asset confirmation is the single largest contributor at 7.5, yet its reading is a neutral 0.5 carried by a proxy. That contribution is a weighting artefact of the 50.0 dimension score rather than observed cross-market stress.

Labour quality is eroding beneath an improving headline: payrolls at -23.0 versus 20.0 prior, participation down to 61.4, and continuing claims up to 1801000, while the jobless rate fell to 4.1. The rate fell for the wrong reason.
The liquidity buffer is thin: overnight reverse repo has drained to 1.45, in the 7.38 percentile, contributing 3.4096 to the score even though the Fed balance sheet ticked up to 6748567.
Leadership is narrow relative to the tape: only 0.1067 of names are making new highs while breadth above the 200-day is 0.6867, and semiconductor relative strength is stretched at 4.6427.

supporting_signals.claim: Volatility is the calmest dimension at 25.15: VIX 15.15 and realized volatility 14.375 leave no implied or delivered stress.
Credit is not flinching: high-yield OAS at 2.71 sits in the 10.29 percentile and investment-grade OAS at 0.78 in the 17.43 percentile.
The trend leg is intact: price is 9.9989 above the 200-day, the 52-week drawdown is 0.0, and 3-month momentum is 5.6973.
Theme participation at the last close was broad: AI Software 6.0538, Quantum Computing 5.7226, Consumer Electronics 5.3946 and Cloud Computing 3.7054.
Downside participation is negligible: the new-lows ratio is 0.0133.

contradicting_signals.claim: The AI supply chain is not moving as one bloc: the memory theme fell -2.202 percent and Micron -0.4424 percent, while A-share memory names rose sharply, GigaDevice 8.3247 percent and Longsys 5.5333 percent. Index-level calm is hiding real dispersion.
The rate complex in the fact layer is dated ahead of the payroll release: 10Y 4.69 and 2Y 4.25 predate the labour print, so the macro dimension at 65.38 may not yet carry the repricing.
Small caps argue against a defensive rotation: small-cap relative strength is 1.1404, which is not what a market de-risking into the caution label normally looks like.
The highest-beta complex is inert rather than risk-seeking: BTC 64958.0, ETH 1919.4 and SOL 75.29 offer no confirmation in either direction.

what_changed_today: Risk appetite improved at the margin: VIX eased from 15.81 to 15.15 and high-yield OAS tightened from 2.75 to 2.71.
Yields backed up across the curve: 10Y from 4.63 to 4.69 and 2Y from 4.18 to 4.25, flattening the 10Y over 2Y spread to 0.44; the real rate rose from 2.41 to 2.43.
The labour picture turned: payrolls from 20.0 to -23.0, unemployment from 4.2 to 4.1, participation from 61.5 to 61.4, and continuing claims from 1777000 to 1801000.
The volatility dimension is fully covered again at coverage 1.0 and effective weight 15.0, lifting model confidence to 0.9211 and evidence coverage to 0.93.
Memory was the weakest theme at -2.202 percent; every theme except FinTech at -0.4307 percent advanced.
watch_next: The CPI release later this week is the decisive print: relayed Chinese reporting frames it as the swing factor for the September Fed decision, against core CPI at 2.56579 and headline at 3.46353.
Whether the memory divergence resolves: the memory theme at -2.202 percent against A-share strength of 8.3247 percent and 5.5333 percent cannot persist indefinitely.

The Hormuz closure has reportedly cut Iraqi crude exports by 75 percent, per relayed Chinese aggregators. No commodity dimension exists in the model, so an energy-led risk-off would reach the score only with a lag through volatility and credit.
Cross-asset confirmation remains a proxy at 0.5 while carrying a 7.5 contribution; resolution in either direction is the largest single mechanical swing available to the score.
Whether the participation-driven fall in the jobless rate reverses; continuing claims at 1801000 is the cleaner read on labour slack than the 4.1 headline.

bull_case.title: Disinflation without a hard landing
points: Core CPI at 2.56579 and core PCE at 3.28653 are both below their prior readings of 2.82294 and 3.42158, and the five-year forward breakeven eased to 2.28 — the path that takes a September hike off the table.
Credit refuses to price trouble: high-yield OAS 2.71 in the 10.29 percentile and investment-grade OAS 0.78 in the 17.43 percentile.
The tape is broad and undamaged: 20 of 22 themes higher, breadth above the 200-day at 0.6867, new lows at 0.0133, and a 52-week drawdown of 0.0.

base_case.title: Caution inside goldilocks — macro-led, not stress-led
points: The score holds near 43.13 with caution and goldilocks intact; a 1-week trend of 1.24 is drift, not a regime break.
Macro at 65.38 stays the only stretched dimension, so the composite is rate-led, while volatility at 25.15 and liquidity and credit at 33.62 keep the floor in place.
AI-linked themes keep leading with wide dispersion — AI Software 6.0538 percent against memory -2.202 percent — so index calm coexists with real single-name risk.

bear_case.title: Rates repricing plus an energy shock the model cannot see
points: The fact layer's rate complex predates the payroll print, so 10Y 4.69 and 2Y 4.25 may understate a hawkish inflation reaction; a real rate above 2.43 with macro already at 65.38 would push the composite out of the caution band.

Relayed reporting puts the Iraqi export loss at 75 percent on the Hormuz closure. With no commodity dimension in the model, an oil-led risk-off would show up late, through volatility currently at 25.15.

Labour quality is eroding under the headline: payrolls -23.0, participation 61.4, continuing claims 1801000. A consumer slowdown would undercut the earnings leg supporting a 9.9989 premium to the 200-day.
